name: Octree Voxel-Triangle Intersection Test
definition: A method to determine if a triangle intersects a voxel within a virtual uniform grid defined by an octree, used for culling or traversal in volume rendering.
summary: The Octree Voxel-Triangle Intersection Test uses the Separating Axis Theorem to accurately detect intersections between triangles and voxels, handling high-frequency geometry better than coarse ray stepping.
